privateDeals.what: Arnault family group plan to simplify its structure (announced 2026-09-23): Financière Agache merges into Agache, then Agache converts to an SCA and merges into Christian Dior, which is renamed Agache SCA; then a mandatory tender offer for the 2.44% of Christian Dior it does not own, at 95% of look-through NAV based on the 1-month average LVMH price (illustrative €469.05/share), with no squeeze-out
LVMH bought ~9% more of Loro Piana from the founding family for ~€1B via call option (85% to 94%)
Agache completed majority takeover of Paris FC (52.4%) alongside Red Bull (10.6%)
